We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.</p> <h1><strong>The Role</strong></h1> <p>We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.</p> <h1><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Set the direction for Enterprise design.</strong> Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.</li> <li><strong>Build and lead the team.</strong> Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Drive design execution across the Enterprise product.</strong> Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.</li> <li><strong>Raise the craft bar.</strong> Uphold design principles and quality standards on your team. Push designers beyond digitizing workflows toward genuinely rethinking how people work with AI. Hold the line on quality without slowing delivery.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to the design system.</strong> Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.</li> <li><strong>Ground the team in user needs.</strong> Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.</li> <li><strong>Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction.</strong> Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1> <ul> <li>5+ years managing product design teams</li> <li>Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into elegant solutions for B2B and beyond</li> <li>Deeply customer-centric, with a track record of grounding design decisions in real user needs and business impact</li> <li>Fluent in how AI is changing design practice and tooling; building AI-native workflows for your team</li> <li>Experience designing for agentic platforms, and excited to shape the future of interaction patterns for AI and human-in-the-loop systems</li> <li>Balance speed and quality; you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and get the team shipping without dropping the craft bar</li> <li>Excellent communicator. You can present to a leaders and a front-line PM and make both feel heard</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE:&nbsp;</em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&amp;</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. imperfect real-world datasets.</li> <li>Strong technical curiosity and a habit of keeping up with current ML and AI research.</li> <li>Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, client-facing teams to bring advanced methods into operational use.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You love applying advanced ML to real-world, high-value physical engineering problems.</li> <li>You're curious about agentic and autonomous approaches and how they can reshape engineering workflows.</li> <li>You enjoy taking ML solutions from research and modelling toward production delivery, and want to build reusable, high-quality systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels. Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability. [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context. TEHCNICAL SKILLSET Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy. Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility. GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short. Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation. Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it. title: Senior Product Manager (Data Products)
description: <div> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement: </strong>2 days per week, Mondays &amp; Wednesdays<br><strong>Employment type:</strong> Permanent<br><strong>Seniority level:</strong> Senior<br><strong>Language:</strong> All stages of the recruitment process will be conducted in English</p> </div> <p>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to play a key role in our Data Product team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As our Senior Product Manager you’ll own a new suite of AI and ML-powered data products at the forefront of innovation in the market research industry. This is a chance to shape how businesses around the world access and act on consumer insight, and to define what AI-native market research looks like rather than follow someone else’s lead.</p> <p>You’ll set the vision and strategy for the suite, turn it into a roadmap, and lead the squad that builds it. You’ll work closely with Data Science, ML and Engineering, as well as Design, Sales, Client Success, Marketing and Finance, with plenty of direct contact with clients and prospects.</p> <p>A few things you’ll be responsible for:</p> <p>👉 Defining the vision, strategy, and positioning of our new AI and data product suite, and how it fits into GWI’s wider platform</p> <p>👉 Identifying where AI and ML create real value for clients, and separating what’s genuinely useful from what’s just novel</p> <p>👉 Working with Data Science and ML Engineering on the models, data, pipelines and methodology behind the products, so they are accurate, reliable, scalable, and trusted</p> <p>👉 Defining how we measure AI quality, including evaluation frameworks, accuracy and reliability benchmarks, and feedback loops, and deciding what “good enough to ship” means</p> <p>👉 Shaping our approach to responsible AI, covering transparency, data governance, privacy and explainability, so clients can trust what the products tell them</p> <p>👉 Building the roadmap from client feedback, market and competitor insight, internal stakeholder input and usage analytics, then prioritising the most valuable work</p> <p>👉 Taking products from early discovery and prototyping through to launch and adoption, including shaping the commercial model, pricing and packaging with Finance and Revenue teams (including usage-based and consumption models)</p> <p>👉 Communicating progress, trade-offs and results clearly to the Exec team and wider business</p> <p>It’s also fun. Shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. In a fast-moving AI landscape, you’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and happy working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don’t have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <p>👉 You’ve shipped AI, ML, data or analytics products at a B2B company, ideally SaaS</p> <p>👉 You understand how AI and ML products are built (for example, LLMs, retrieval, agents, predictive models)&nbsp;</p> <p>👉 You’re comfortable with data. You can work with engineers on data quality, modelling, and delivery (APIs, dashboards, integrations)</p> <p>👉 You’ve built complex roadmaps with cross-functional dependencies, and you can balance multiple priorities without losing the plot</p> <p>👉 You make informed decisions at pace, even when the picture isn’t complete, and you’re happy taking a big initiative and running with it</p> <p>👉 You’re a strong problem solver, negotiator, and influencer. You get alignment without needing authority</p> <p>👉 You explain complex things clearly to very different audiences: execs, engineers, customers</p> <p>👉 You ask questions and draw knowledge out of your team to find the right engineering, data science and design solutions</p> <p>👉 Bonus points if you’ve worked in market research, consumer insight or analytics, with large-scale survey or behavioural datasets, or on usage-based pricing for AI or API products</p> <p>Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Why Join Us</h1> <p>👉 You’ll work on a new AI-powered product suite at the leading edge of the market research industry</p> <p>👉 You’ll build on GWI’s large-scale consumer datasets, a strong foundation for AI products that competitors can’t easily replicate</p> <p>👉 You’ll have room to shape the strategy and run your own squad your way<br><br><br></p> <h1>What We Offer 🧘</h1> <p>At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:</p> <ul> <li>Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.</li> <li>Health &amp; wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.</li> <li>Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.</li> <li>Flexibility &amp; balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.</li> <li>Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.</li> <li>Community &amp; impact – DE&amp;I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.</li> </ul> <p>Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU?si=dIgYyrKaAlNZK-NQ" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-LV1</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Direct collaboration with our core marketing team

  • Fair compensation, clear goals, and short decision paths

  • The chance to help build Mammutmarsch in the UK from day one

Your application

raw.title: Ops Associate
raw.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

The role

At Parallel, we work with a team of 25+ freelance TIMs (medical information technicians) on different tasks, in particular retrieving medical documents from our partner facilities’ software. This is a core part of Parallel. With fast, secure access to our partner facilities’ data, we code the first hospital stays within a few days and prove Parallel’s ROI. Then we automate document extraction so we can scale.

As Ops Associate, you support the Ops team on managing freelancers and on cross-functional Ops projects. You take ownership of critical operational topics end to end and contribute directly to Parallel’s growth. You work daily with our Head of Ops, the Deployment Strategists, Customer Care and our freelance TIMs.

You’re in charge of staffing and managing our network of freelance TIMs and become their main point of contact, working directly with our Head of Ops. You also work on cross-functional projects that structure Ops as Parallel scales. It’s a chance to see first-hand how a generative AI solution is deployed in hospitals, and to experience a startup’s scale-up from the inside.

What you’ll do

Staffing and management of freelance TIMs

You’re responsible for the network of freelance TIMs who support our clients. You make sure the right person is on the right assignment, at the right time, within a compliant framework.

  • Sourcing and recruiting: identify, qualify and recruit new TIMs based on needs (specialties, facilities, volume).

  • Staffing assignments: assign TIMs to client accounts, anticipate workload peaks and manage priorities.

  • Onboarding: train new TIMs on the Parallel tool and our ways of working.

  • Monitoring: centralize assignment tracking and manage the team’s performance.

  • Contracts and compliance: keep freelance contracts up to date, in line with our ISO 27001 and HDS requirements (data access, confidentiality).

Cross-functional Ops projects

You support the Ops team on cross-functional projects to make processes more robust and scalable. For example, you could:

  • Compliance and security: contribute to the ISO 27001 and HDS certification project on the Ops side (registers, evidence, access reviews, contracts).

  • Processes and documentation: keep client training notes up to date and improve internal playbooks (deployment, support).

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re looking for your first permanent job, or possibly an end-of-studies internship (with the goal of staying with us on a permanent contract).

  • You’re rigorous: you organize yourself, prioritize, and follow your topics through to the end.

  • You have strong people skills: you can adapt to profiles very different from yours, explain technical topics and bring a team along.

  • You’re comfortable in a tech environment and like understanding how software works so you can help others use it.

  • You’re autonomous: when you’re given an assignment, you figure out how to set up the right processes and resources to get it done.

Why join us?

  • Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

  • A central role: you work with Ops, Product, Tech and the field teams.

  • Room to grow: we’re hiring for this role to help someone grow with us over time.

  • The right time: Series A closed, product already used by ~100 hospitals, a fast-growing team.

  • The package: Alan health insurance, Swile, Apple equipment, 50% of transport covered, a team event every month and two off-sites a year.

  • Our offices: Paris 2nd arrondissement, boulevard de Sébastopol.

The process

  1. Call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min)

  2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

  3. Case study with Clémentine and Jules and meeting with Paul, CEO

  4. Offer

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

direction à l'équipe.</p> <p><strong>Localisation: Paris, France</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li>Rencontrer les propriétaires d'éditeurs de logiciels et partager la financières et élaborer des modèles de valorisation financière.</li> <li>Diriger les travaux de due diligence afin d’identifier les principaux risques et opportunités des entreprises cibles.</li> raw.description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further.

  • Cloud: AWS

  • Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python)

  • Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense

  • Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA)

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry

  • Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM

  • Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app

Some of this is clean, version-controlled, and reproducible. Other parts grew fast and live a little too much in people’s heads instead of in code. Closing that gap is a big part of why this role exists.

Over the next year, we'll focus on:

  • Making every environment reproducible from code

  • Better observability and alerting, fewer surprises

  • Tightening the security and compliance posture that comes with handling enterprise finance data

  • Faster, safer deploys

  • Keeping AWS costs sane as we scale

  • Backend expertise: APIs, microservices, architecture best practices

  • Databases & SQL: Data modeling, query optimization

  • Git lover: Comfortable with version control and code reviews

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset: Build, test, refine, simplify—smart shortcuts when time is tight

🧩 Bonus points if you’ve worked on:

  • B2B SaaS or finance/ERP tools

  • BaaS APIs or payment infra

  • Serverless, AWS, event-driven architecture exposure

✨ Who's going to thrive with us

You'll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You think in systems and instinctively automate yourself out of repetitive work.

  • You treat infrastructure as code, not as pets.

  • You stay calm during incidents and are genuinely good at root-causing.

  • You care about security, because you're handling other people's money.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You're pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

You don't need to know everything about AI - but you must be curious about it and excited to build the reliable foundation that agents run on 🤖

🧩 What you'll get from this role

  • Real ownership over the platform the whole company runs on.

  • Direct impact on reliability, security, and how fast every engineer can ship.

Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont une centaine d'associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".


Dans un environnement économique où le cash est devenu un levier stratégique de création de valeur, l'équipe Working Capital de la Service Line Transformation Finance accompagne les actionnaires, les directions générales, financières et opérationnelles dans l'amélioration durable de leur performance cash et de leur efficacité opérationnelle.

Nous intervenons auprès de fonds d'investissement, de corporates et de family offices sur des problématiques à fort enjeu : optimisation du BFR, pilotage du cash-flow, transformation des processus Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay et Inventory-to-Cash, l’amélioration de la performance opérationnelle, l’exploitation avancée de la donnée et le déploiement des solutions digitales innovantes.

Notre approche combine expertise métier, excellence analytique, technologies de pointe et conduite du changement afin de générer des impacts financiers et opérationnels mesurables et durables.

Ce que nous faisons :

Performance Cash & Working Capital

  •       Réalisation de diagnostics 360° du BFR et du cash-flow.

  •       Identification et quantification des leviers d'amélioration sur les cycles clients, fournisseurs, stocks et dettes d'exploitation.

  •       Construction de trajectoires de création de cash et de plans de transformation.

  •       Définition et déploiement d'une véritable culture cash à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.

Data Analytics & Cash Intelligence

  •       Exploitation de larges volumes de données ERP, comptables et opérationnelles.

  •       Modélisation avancée des indicateurs de performance (DSO, DPO, DIO, CCC).

  •       Développement de dashboards décisionnels sous Power BI et outils de data visualisation.

  •       Utilisation de l'IA et des technologies avancées d'analyse pour détecter les opportunités de création de valeur.

Prévisions de trésorerie & Pilotage de la performance

  •       Conception de modèles de prévision de trésorerie court, moyen et long terme.

  •       Amélioration de la fiabilité des cash forecasts.

  •       Développement d'outils de simulation et d'analyse prédictive.

  •       Accompagnement des directions financières dans la sécurisation de leur liquidité.

Transformation Finance & Digitalisation

  •       Facturation électronique.

  •       Automatisation des processus financiers.

  •       Workflows et outils collaboratifs.

  •       IA générative, copilotes métiers et agents intelligents.

  •       Modernisation des outils de pilotage et de reporting.

Vos missions

Au sein d'une équipe entrepreneuriale en forte croissance, vous participerez à l'ensemble des phases des missions (liste non exhaustive):

Analyse de données et création de valeur

  •       Exploiter des bases de données complexes issues des ERP, CRM et outils financiers.

  •       Identifier les gisements de cash et les opportunités d'amélioration du BFR.

  •       Construire des analyses quantitatives à fort impact pour les directions générales et financières.

  •       Fiabiliser la donnée et les indicateurs de performance.

Diagnostic et transformation des processus

  •       Cartographier les processus Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay et Inventory-to-Cash.

  •       Identifier les ruptures opérationnelles et les causes racines de sous-performance.

  •       Quantifier les impacts financiers associés aux recommandations formulées.

Data, IA et outils de nouvelle génération

  •       Elaborer des data models et développer des dashboards et outils d'analyse (Power Pivot, Query, BI, …)

  •       Participer au déploiement de solutions d'automatisation et utiliser de manière ciblée et pragmatique l'intelligence artificielle par le développement de prompts, agents, …., pour concevoir des modèles analytiques et prédictifs au service de la performance cash.

  •       Utiliser les technologies digitales les plus récentes pour accélérer la prise de décision.

Accompagnement client

  •       Préparer et animer des ateliers avec les directions Finance, Supply Chain, Commerce et Opérations.

  •       Contribuer à la production de livrables exécutifs pour les Comex et Directions Générales.

  •       Accompagner la mise en œuvre des plans d'actions et la conduite du changement.

What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
description: <p>AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.</p> <p>Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.</p> <p>The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.</li> <li>Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.</li> <li>Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.</li> <li>Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.</li> <li>Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and experimentation pillar — so that what you learn moves freely in both directions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a PhD, MS or equivalent research experience in a scientific field, with strong applied mathematics grounding.</li> <li>6+ years of relevant applied science or ML engineering experience, including setting technical direction for others.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent post-training data: how it is created, managed, and how training-data quality is controlled. This is the requirement that matters most.</li> <li>You have real domain expertise in LLMs and agentic applications — not classical ML fine-tuning. Fine-tuning classifiers or traditional models is a different problem from the one this team is solving.</li> <li>You have evaluated agents or LLM applications, and can define what 'good' means before you measure it.</li> <li>You are a strong programmer and production software engineer. Python at minimum, plus the ability to ship scalable production systems and work with distributed systems.</li> <li>You collaborate well across engineering and science teams, and you're comfortable being the domain expert who decides what comes next.</li> <li>You thrive in ambiguity and can make sound technical calls when the path isn't yet defined.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on LLM fine-tuning, post-training or model training experience.</li> <li>Background in statistics, experiment design and data analysis.</li> <li>Experience deploying production-level ML infrastructure.</li> <li>Observability or monitoring systems background.</li> <li>Architecture-level understanding of LLMs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Growth:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture and the ability to join our Community Guilds</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Director, Engineering - Digital Experience Monitoring
description: <p>Datadog's Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) group is one of the company's fastest-growing product areas, spanning Real User Monitoring (RUM), Product Analytics, Synthetic Monitoring, Feature Flags, and Datadog Studio, our newest AI-native observability surface. As Director, you will own engineering for one or more of these product areas, with scope shaped by your background and interests, and you will manage 50-60 engineers through a team of Engineering Managers. You'll partner with Senior Directors and product leadership to shape the roadmap, not just execute against it, and you'll help drive AI adoption across engineering tooling, workflows, and product features. This role is based in Paris, one of Datadog's most established engineering hubs, with a clear growth path to Senior Director for the right candidate.<br><br></p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. description: <p><strong>Job title:</strong> Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French &amp; English)&nbsp;<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Paris — Hybrid (3 days in office)<br><br><strong>Salary:</strong> €57,600 - €72,000<br><br><strong>Team:</strong> Product Management - Data Device Management&nbsp;<br><br><strong>Reporting to: </strong>Group Product Manager</p> <p><strong>This role is based in Paris, France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to Paris. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship<br><br>Please submit your profile in English.&nbsp;<br></strong></p> <p>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.&nbsp;</p> <p>By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.</p> <p>With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <p>You'll lead the French localisation of Device Data Management — one of the core product areas within the Kaluza platform that brings together data on supplies, meters, registers, reads and consumption. This area also covers the journeys around managing this data (like updating a meter's configuration), the APIs that expose it, the frontend pages that surface it to users, and the calculations behind consumption projection and forecasting. This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole product area, from the data model through to what users see on screen.</p> <ul> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2" data-sourcepos="27:1-27:280;1959-2238"><strong>Translate French market requirements into clear specifications</strong> — turn the rules of the French energy market (including how device and meter data flows between grid operators and suppliers) into detailed product requirements covering compliance, data flows and data quality.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2" data-sourcepos="28:1-28:289;2239-2527"><strong>Build close working relationships</strong> — work hand in hand with key partners in the French market to understand their needs, shape requirements together, and build the kind of trusted relationship where they come to you first, using that closeness to steer what we build next for France.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2" data-sourcepos="29:1-29:286;2528-2813"><strong>Build, don't just specify.</strong> Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, sketch API contracts, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2" data-sourcepos="30:1-30:327;2814-3140"><strong>Align global and local teams across all functions</strong> — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with full-stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes. Be the go-to person for this product area in France, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About You<br><br>Ideally you'll have/be:<br></strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Proven experience </strong>as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or<strong> </strong>equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets</li> <li><strong>Previous experience in the French energy industry</strong> — you know how the market works and its key players (e.g. Enedis / GRDF), especially around device data and market flows. Experience with energy management or utility platforms in the French market is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and very comfortable in English</strong> — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.</li> <li><strong>Confident working directly with clients</strong> — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.</li> <li><strong>A builder's mentality</strong> — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.</li> <li><strong>Technically comfortable</strong> — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one and can hold your own in a technical conversation. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.</li> <li><strong>A clear, sharp communicator</strong> — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.</li> <li><strong>Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams</strong> — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in AI tools </strong>throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Kaluza Values</strong></p> <p>Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together</strong></p> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td>&nbsp;</td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>We want the best people</strong></p> <p>We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.</p> <p>We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.</p> <p>Find out more about working at&nbsp;<a href="http://kaluza.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://kaluza.com&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1772730023496000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2WQ4QggVd_VKIz_hhKv_E_">Kaluza</a>&nbsp;on our&nbsp;<a href="https://kaluza-dev.webflow.io/careers" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://kaluza-dev.webflow.io/careers&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1772730023496000&amp;usg=AOvVaw0ieu808CO6v15ojfSZWHzP">careers page</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1772730023496000&amp;usg=AOvVaw1r5cAEyzI_Xc26WGuLbLZx">LinkedIn</a>.<br><br>You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy <a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice">here</a>.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Vous serez en charge de la localisation française du module de facturation, l’un des domaines produit centraux au cœur de la plateforme Kaluza, responsable de conduire un client du relevé de compteur à la facture. Le module de facturation consomme les données de consommation, de tarification et de compte pour planifier, calculer et générer des factures exactes, émises dans les délais et conformes, tout au long du cycle de vie du client. Le module gère automatiquement les cycles de facturation, génère les factures, traite les corrections et produit les données qui alimentent les factures, les communications liées à la facturation, les échéanciers de paiement, le reporting financier en aval, ainsi que les interfaces clients et agents. parcours de facturation global, du compteur à la facture, répond aux exigences des clients français.</p> <ul> <li>Collaborer intensément avec les clients et les experts locaux pour comprendre leurs besoins et exigences spécifiques, négocier le périmètre et construire une roadmap.</li> <li>Plonger dans les réglementations du marché français de l’énergie, en traduisant des besoins de conformité complexes en spécifications produit détaillées pour le système de facturation.</li> <li>Définir et gérer des exigences produit détaillées pour les fonctionnalités liées aux besoins spécifiques au pays, de l’obtention d’un relevé à la génération d’une facture (protocoles de relevé de compteur, formats de facture, règles de taxation, modes de paiement et reporting réglementaire).</li> <li>Travailler étroitement avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’UX et de test (qualité) pour assurer la réussite de la mise en œuvre et des tests des fonctionnalités de facturation localisées.</li> <li>Agir en tant qu’expert de référence pour les équipes globales sur les spécificités du marché français liées à la facturation d’énergie et aux parcours clients.</li> <li>Surveiller en continu les réussite dans la localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.</li> <li>Une compréhension solide du cycle de vie de facturation B2C de bout en bout, y compris les données de comptage, les tarifs, la facturation et la gestion de la dette.</li> <li>Une expérience dans des marchés régulés où la complexité de la facturation compte : énergie, télécoms, services financiers ou équivalent. Une familiarité avec le marché français de l’énergie (ENGIE, CRE, changement de fournisseur, structures tarifaires) est un avantage.</li> <li>Une capacité exceptionnelle à traduire des textes réglementaires abstraits ou des exigences clients en exigences claires, actionnables et orientées résultats pour les équipes de développement.</li> <li>Une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, juridique, opérations, réussite client) pour livrer des solutions localisées.</li> <li>D’excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et des clients, capable de mener les discussions sur les exigences, le périmètre, les attentes et l’alignement de la roadmap, et de communiquer clairement la complexité technique et de marché à des publics variés.</li> <li>La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation à la livraison et l’itération.</li> <li>Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur : vous êtes autonome, vous apprenez vite et vous n’avez pas peur d’aller en profondeur. title: Product Line Manager
description: About Wallee Group AG Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers. The Role The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy. In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products. The Impact You’ll Make Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes. Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization. Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives. Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis. Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals. Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

title: Junior Product Manager – IT Fulfillment
description: <h6>Every order a Suitsupply customer places, online, in a store, or through customer service, has to be captured, understood and carried all the way through to delivery or return. The Group Product Manager shapes the functional direction with the business and sets priorities; together you turn it into clear requirements, well-defined tickets and working software, built with engineers and AI agents. This is a technical product role: we build our own services, so you will spend your time in data models, interfaces and requirements rather than managing a vendor’s roadmap. You start close to delivery, with support while you learn the domain, and grow into owning more of the roadmap.</h6> <h5><strong>What you will do</strong></h5> <ul> <li>Turn mapped-out functional flows into clear, buildable work: technical requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories that engineers and AI agents can pick up without coming back with questions.</li> <li>Own the detail as both product manager and business analyst: the data model, the way systems talk to each other, and the edge cases nobody thought of yet.</li> <li>Break large changes into chunks that can be built, tested and released safely, and keep the backlog in a state where work can start at any moment.</li> <li>Work with engineers day to day in refinement, planning, reviews and releases, and use our AI tooling to draft, structure and pressure-test the work before it reaches them.</li> <li>Design our order data and interfaces so that AI agents can read, reason over and act on them as reliably as our own systems do.</li> <li>Create visibility across the end-to-end fulfillment journey, so anyone from a customer service agent to a supply chain lead can see where an order is and what happened to it, and turn that into measures the business trusts.</li> <li>Take on discovery for smaller and mid-sized roadmap items as your domain knowledge builds: the options, the trade-offs and the recommendation.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Who you are</strong></h5> <ul> <li>Business analysis experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner. title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description: Als ervaren Customer Solutions Engineer  bij Payter ben jij dé expert die klanten helpt bij complexe technische vraagstukken, het diagnosticeren van problemen en het oplossen van geëscaleerde klantvragen. Je begeleidt gebruikers door geavanceerde troubleshooting van onze producten, geeft deskundig advies en verzorgt producttrainingen als het belangrijkste technische aanspreekpunt. Als diepgaande specialist van het Payter-platform deel je best-practice advies en werk je nauw samen met diverse interne teams om complexe of unieke technische escalaties succesvol op te lossen.  Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Onderzoeken en oplossen van complexe technische problemen, vragen over softwareversies en hardware-uitdagingen, inclusief ondersteuning bij updates, transactiefouten en de doorstroom van telemetriedata. Verzorgen van geavanceerde terminalconfiguraties, remote diagnostics en support bij de uitrol, evenals het oplossen van netwerkproblemen (wifi, 5G, LAN) en integraties van randapparatuur. Fungeren als dé technische autoriteit op het gebied van Payter-hardware en -software, waaronder cloud-API's, TCP/IP-socketconnectiviteit en fysieke installatieprocedures. Bieden van deskundig technisch advies aan gebruikers over de beste oplossingen voor integratie en dagelijks gebruik. Efficiënt beheren van supporttickets en het leveren van gedetailleerde technische oplossingen via telefoon, e-mail, video of chat. Nauw samenwerken met collega's en engineering-teams om een klantgerichte service te leveren, kwaliteitsstandaarden te waarborgen en operationele workflows te stroomlijnen. Nauwkeurig documenteren van alle technische interacties en het ontwikkelen van best practices voor de interne kennisbank. Signaleren en delen van kansen voor product- en procesverbeteringen op basis van klantfeedback, om zo de algehele gebruikerservaring te blijven optimaliseren. Over Payter Bij Payter zijn we pioniers en leiders op het gebied van contactloze en cashless betaaloplossingen in uiteenlopende markten, zoals elektrisch laden (EV), openbaar vervoer, retail, horeca, vending, goede doelen en parkeren. Het flexibele Payter-platform ondersteunt een breed scala aan betaaltechnologieën (waaronder NFC, EMV, Apple Pay en Google Pay), internationale bankprocessen, closed-loop betaal- en loyaliteitssystemen, en telemetrie. Door continue innovatie en in-house ontwikkeling herdefiniëren we hoe verkopers in contact staan met hun klanten. We stellen hen in staat om de omzet te verhogen, de gebruikerservaring te verbeteren en realtime toegang te krijgen tot verkoop- en prestatiedata. Onze hoogwaardige producten ondersteunen technologieën zoals Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth en touchscreens. Ze hebben een extreem lange levensduur, voldoen aan internationale standaarden, blinken uit in design, en zijn uiterst gebruiksvriendelijk en eenvoudig te integreren. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een integratie-supportrol, of 3 tot 4 jaar in een technische supportfunctie voor diverse producten. Je hebt praktische kennis van HTTP, JSON/XML APIs, en TCP/IP-socketcommunicatie. Je kunt goed overweg met Postman en Swagger; ervaring met softwareontwikkeling is een grote pre. Je bent bij voorkeur bekend met industrieprotocollen zoals OCPP/OCPI, MDB of EMV. Je hebt een brede achtergrond op het gebied van technische support, testen, documentatie en training. Je beschikt over bewezen probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een proactieve gedrevenheid om te leren hoe nieuwe technologieën werken. Je bent sociaal vaardig, spreekt vloeiend professioneel Engels en hebt een oprechte klantgerichte mindset. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal. Je bent minimaal 3 dagen per week aanwezig op kantoor. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar ben je er wel van overtuigd dat je de kwaliteiten voor deze functie in huis hebt? Dan nodigen we je uit om toch te solliciteren. We laten ons graag overtuigen. Wat bieden wij? Bij Payter geloven we dat een fijne werkomgeving de basis is voor succes. Daarom bieden wij jou: Een verzorgde lunch op kantoor, zodat je samen met collega's kunt genieten van een goede pauze. 25 vakantiedagen om voldoende tijd te nemen voor ontspanning. 12 Balance Days per jaar, iedere maand ontvang je een extra vrije dag voor een gezonde werk-privébalans. Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling, waarbij jij slechts 3,6% van de premie bijdraagt en Payter het grootste deel voor haar rekening neemt. Ruimte voor groei, met volop professionele ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en trainingen. Een goed bereikbaar kantoor in Rotterdam. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes

Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Met AEP Hybrid Power richten we ons op innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica. In jouw rol werk je aan projecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Denk aan converters, ultracapacitors, besturingstechniek, elektrische installaties en energieopslag. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van engineering, productie, sales en service, maar hebt ook regelmatig contact met klanten, leveranciers en productiepartners. Hierdoor ben je betrokken bij het volledige traject van een project en zie je jouw werk uiteindelijk letterlijk in de praktijk terug. Ben je een sterke starter met passende stages of projecten? Ook dan komen we graag met je in gesprek • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Duits is een pré • Je vindt het leuk om incidenteel klanten en productiepartners in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken • Je bent gestructureerd, planmatig en houdt goed overzicht • Je bent technisch analytisch en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar duidelijke acties • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet verschillende partijen op een prettige manier met elkaar te verbinden • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en wacht niet af wanneer er actie nodig is Wat kan jij van ons verwachten? Binnen AEP kom je terecht in een technische en groeiende organisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen inbreng. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan innovatieve projecten binnen de energietechniek en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. title: Junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames
description: Ben jij het zonnetje in huis? En heb jij al affiniteit met de wereld van bedrijfsovernames? Lees dan vooral verder! Wij zoeken namelijk een junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames. Je bent - samen met een senior collega - verantwoordelijk voor het gehele overnameproces van MKB bedrijven. Wat is je takenpakket? Je stelt anonieme overname profielen en informatiememoranda op en controleert ze Je spreekt met geïnteresseerden, nadat deze door je collega’s gekwalificeerd zijn Je voert onderhandelingsgesprekken met geïnteresseerden Je maakt de deal en het begeleidt het LOI-proces Je onderhoud korte lijnen met jouw klant (de ondernemer die zijn bedrijf gaat verkopen). Die voelt dat jij aan z’n kant staat. We hebben specialisten op elk gebied van het bedrijfsovernameproces; waardebepalingen, juridische afwikkeling en het informeren van geïnteresseerden. Dit is dus allemaal al geregeld en hoeft dus niet alles zelf te doen. Ondanks dat dit niet bij jouw verantwoordelijkheden hoort, krijg je hier wel alles van mee. We werken namelijk als een team. Mocht je ervaring en interesse hier liggen, dan kunnen we je takenpakket hiermee uitbreiden. Wie is onze ideale kandidaat? Je hebt affiniteit met overname processen Je communiceert op een natuurlijke en informele wijze met diverse partijen Je hebt affiniteit hebt met cijfers en je kunt uit de voeten met jaarrekeningen en financiële rapportages Je vind het leuk jezelf te verplaatsen in MKB ondernemers uit diverse sectoren en van allerlei niveau’s Je hebt overredingskracht en geeft tegengas aan je klant wanneer het nodig is Je hebt een winnaarsmentaliteit en gaat daarvoor graag “the extra mile” Je kunt gemakkelijk tussen cases schakelen: bij een fulltime dienstverband werk je doorgaans aan 10-15 cases tegelijkertijd Over Take 5 Over het algemeen zijn ondernemers ongeduldige mensen. Het liefst is alles gisteren al gebeurd. Wij kennen het overnameproces. We zijn hierin deskundig en ervaren. Dat wil zeggen: we hebben alle expertise in huis om een MKB’er zo goed mogelijk mee te nemen en we doen dit al een hele tijd. Het verkopen van een bedrijf doen MKB ondernemers maximaal 1-2 keer in hun leven. Ze staan hun kindje af. Dit is een emotioneel en spannend proces. Wij zijn toegewijd en pro-actief. We zijn streng op de kwalificatie en nemen alleen genoegen met het beste voor de ondernemer. We zijn authentiek en gelijkwaardig. Dat wil zeggen: we gaan naast een ondernemer staan en nemen die stap voor stap mee. We gebruiken ons karakter en eigenaardigheden om de connectie met de ondernemer te maken.
